canonical_chain: X_micro -> C_lane -> (C_lane,Phi,Pi) -> (T_munu,N_mu,Q_mu,sigma) -> R_gen -> carrier -> R_obs -> p_A(o|a)

postulates.name: declared_physical_state
postulates.falsification_condition: declared state does not determine fixed-input predictions
postulates.prohibited_inference: coordinates are not automatically matter, energy, information, or observables

postulates.name: lane_specific_collective_coordinate
postulates.standard_physics_counterpart: order parameters, hydrodynamic densities, and Noether densities
postulates.falsification_condition: no stable refinement-consistent lane map exists
postulates.prohibited_inference: C is not universal mass, energy, force, probability, or charge

postulates.name: conservative_generator
postulates.standard_physics_counterpart: Lagrangian, Hamiltonian, and variational field theory
postulates.falsification_condition: declared equations or currents are not derivatives of the same generator
postulates.prohibited_inference: separate ansatz equations are not one derived conservative theory

postulates.name: open_system_reduction
postulates.falsification_condition: positivity, entropy, fluctuation-dissipation, or exchange balance fails
postulates.prohibited_inference: normalized damping is not automatically microscopic dissipation

postulates.name: causal_physical_influence
postulates.falsification_condition: influence precedes its declared cone or lacks a physical ledger
postulates.prohibited_inference: carrier identity is not inferred from the word information

postulates.name: detector_generated_record
postulates.falsification_condition: observer protocol alone changes source dynamics
postulates.prohibited_inference: records are not an independent substance

postulates.name: operational_quantum_probability
postulates.standard_physics_counterpart: density operators, CPTP channels, POVMs, and the Born rule
postulates.falsification_condition: positivity, normalization, no-signalling, or benchmark gates fail
postulates.prohibited_inference: QBism or RQM does not alter propagation equations by interpretation alone

postulates.name: derived_persistence_selection
postulates.standard_physics_counterpart: stochastic thermodynamics, survival analysis, and dynamical selection
postulates.falsification_condition: physical resource/failure mapping has no holdout value beyond baseline
postulates.prohibited_inference: persistence is not intention or a universal least-energy law

postulates.name: competing_closed_and_nonclosed_branches
postulates.standard_physics_counterpart: nested-model testing and covariant stress-energy balance
postulates.falsification_condition: closed limit is discontinuous or alternative fails penalized holdout comparison
